title: Number Patterns: Sequences and Series
summary: Arithmetic and geometric sequences and series, sigma notation, the sum to infinity of a convergent geometric series, and solving problems with patterns.

notes.text: An **arithmetic** sequence has a constant **common difference** $d$. First term $a$.

notes.caption: General term and sum of the first $n$ terms ($l$ = last term)

notes.text: A **geometric** sequence has a constant **common ratio** $r = \dfrac{T_2}{T_1} = \dfrac{T_3}{T_2}$.

notes.caption: General term and sum of the first $n$ terms

notes.label: Number of terms
notes.text: $\sum_{k=p}^{q}$ has $q - p + 1$ terms. For $\sum_{k=3}^{10}$ there are $10 - 3 + 1 = 8$ terms.
A geometric series **converges** (has a finite sum to infinity) only if $-1 < r < 1$, $r \neq 0$.

notes.title: Worked example 4
notes.problem: Find the sum to infinity of $24 + 12 + 6 + \ldots$
steps: $r = \frac{1}{2}$, which lies between $-1$ and $1$, so the series converges.

notes.title: Worked example 5: convergence
notes.problem: For which values of $x$ does $\displaystyle\sum_{k=1}^{\infty}(2x - 1)^k$ converge?
